title: Assassin's Creed Shadows
description: An open-world Assassin's Creed adventure set in late Sengoku-period Japan, starring shinobi Naoe and samurai Yasuke. The Switch 2 version targets 30 fps, supports touch controls, HDR output, save-data cloud and Ubisoft Connect cross-progression.

fitFor: Players who enjoy large historical open worlds

gameplayPillars.title: Shinobi stealth
gameplayPillars.description: Naoe uses shadows, sound, prone movement, grappling, kunai, shuriken and the Hidden Blade.

gameplayPillars.title: Samurai combat
gameplayPillars.description: Yasuke relies on powerful melee weapons, posture attacks, blocks and parries.

gameplayPillars.title: Reactive open world
gameplayPillars.description: Weather and seasons affect stealth, traversal and the visual state of the environment.

worldSummary: The game recreates late-16th-century Japan across castle towns, ports, shrines, countryside and forests. Seasonal changes alter vegetation, water, visibility and infiltration opportunities, while a spy network and scouts help uncover targets and locations.

storyChapters.title: Naoe's path
storyChapters.body: A shinobi from Iga pursues revenge and an impossible promise after conflict reaches her homeland.

storyChapters.title: Yasuke's path
storyChapters.body: The historical African samurai serves as the game's combat-focused protagonist while confronting his past.

storyChapters.title: A shared destiny
storyChapters.body: Their stories intersect amid political upheaval, secret factions and the struggle surrounding Japan's unification.

features: Two protagonists with distinct stealth/combat systems

perfNotes: Ubisoft officially targets 30 fps in both modes. Technical analysis reports aggressive dynamic internal resolution and reconstruction; the exact internal pixel count varies by scene.

devicePerformance.sourceName: Switch 2 launch coverage; Ubisoft has not published a full official spec sheet

storageNotes: Nintendo eShop lists 68.9 GB required space for the base Switch 2 game. The Game-Key Card requires the full game download. Premium Edition is larger because it includes Claws of Awaji and additional content.
languagesText: French / German / Italian / Spanish / Portuguese / Russian

dlc.name: The Claws of Awaji
dlc.title: The Claws of Awaji
dlc.description: Story expansion set on Awaji island (around 10 extra hours). Not included with the Nintendo Switch 2 release — sold separately, arriving in 2026.

faq.q: Can the Switch 2 version be played offline?
faq.a: Yes after installation. Ubisoft states an internet connection is required for installation, after which the main game can be played offline.
Ubisoft officially targets 30 fps in both handheld and docked modes.

faq.q: Is Claws of Awaji available on Switch 2?
faq.a: Yes. The expansion released for Switch 2 on March 10, 2026.

verdictSummary: A technically ambitious portable conversion of Ubisoft's feudal-Japan open world. The dual-protagonist design is its biggest strength, while the Switch 2 version necessarily uses aggressive reconstruction and a 30 fps target.
verdictPros: Rich feudal-Japan world and seasonal systems
